decisions.title: Enzo Fernández Speaks Out on World Cup Final Red Card, Skips the Apology
decisions.reason: This story carries no Israeli competition, athlete or team angle — it concerns only Argentina and Spain's men's national teams at the 2026 World Cup final. Per desk policy, confidence is set to 0 and the piece is held for editorial review rather than published on the Israeli sports desk. All match, red-card and quote facts are independently verified across NBC News, Yahoo Sports, ESPN, FIFA's official match record, Goal.com, LadBible and the Mirror; the 1-0 scoreline is confirmed as full-time/after extra time by FIFA.com, ESPN and multiple other outlets and matches the single reported goal event (Ferran Torres).

decisions.title: Omri Glazer lands in Israel to seal Maccabi Haifa return
decisions.reason: Outlets differ slightly on the exact transfer fee (reported between €250,000 and €300,000); no source has yet confirmed the medical/signing is fully complete, only that terms were agreed and Glazer arrived to finalize the move.
